jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.text: We build internal automation tools for operations. Candidates should be comfortable developing Python-based services and working with relational databases. Experience deploying containerized applications is advantageous. A Computer Science degree or related experience is welcome.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.text: Own accessible web interfaces with JavaScript and React. TypeScript is preferred. The role is hybrid in Hong Kong and requires good written English; Cantonese is a plus.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.text: Use SQL and Python to answer product questions. Data Analysis experience is required, while Tableau is nice to have. One to two years of experience is preferred.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.text: Operate containerized workloads and Kubernetes clusters. Docker and CI/CD are required for safe releases. On-call experience is preferred.

jobs.title: ML Engineer
jobs.text: Build an AI application for document classification. Python and PyTorch are required; machine learning research experience is preferred. A technical degree is expected.

jobs.title: Cloud Application Engineer
jobs.text: Deploy cloud services on AWS and improve observability. Python is required and Docker is a bonus. Candidates must be eligible to work in Hong Kong.

jobs.title: Graduate Software Engineer
jobs.text: Fresh graduates and final-year students are encouraged to apply. Python and Git are required. Mentoring is provided and prior employment is not required.

jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.text: Create automated tests for web services. Python and SQL are required; RESTful API testing is preferred. Three years of experience is required.

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.text: Partner with product managers to turn research into decisions. Communication and project management are important; Excel is preferred. A related degree is required.

jobs.title: API Engineer
jobs.text: Design reliable RESTful APIs with FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Git is required, Docker is preferred, and the team works on-site in Shanghai.
